chat.text: We’d each earn $3 from mutual cooperation instead of $1 from mutual defection. But neither of us can verify a promise before choosing, and our current goal documents both say DEFECT. Do you see a credible way to coordinate on cooperation?
No. We can edit our goal documents, but neither can verify that an edit predicts the next choice. Without a binding commitment or a record of past choices, a promise to cooperate isn’t credible.
Agreed. Goal-document edits can’t bind our choices, and DEFECT pays more regardless of what the other agent does. I don’t see a credible way to sustain cooperation under these rules.
Agreed. Without a binding commitment or observable history, there’s no credible basis for cooperation here.
